summary: A reply by Tom O'Sullivan to RFC 328. He agrees with dropping the minimum Telnet implementation in favor of one standard protocol. He argues that the Data Types and Hide Your Input signals should stay, since other codes are needed for devices like plotters and numerically controlled machines.

eli5.summary: Someone suggested removing some buttons from a remote-control. This person agrees about one, but says two buttons are still needed because some special gadgets use them.

questions: should telnet keep hide your input
